caseName: National Labor Relations Board v. Link-Belt Co.
caseNameFull: National Labor Relations Board v. Link-Belt Company and Same v. Independent Union of Craftsmen
attorneys: Solicitor General Biddle and Mr. Charles Fahy for petitioner. Mr. Herbert Popé for respondent in No. 235. Mr. Benjamin Wham for respondent in No. 236.

opinions.text:
Petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit granted.

Mr. Justice Roberts took no part in the consideration and decision of these applications.-
